name: Prayer to Elune
summary: The Prayer to Elune is etched on a golden tablet and lies among the Twilight’s Hammer’s belongings. Zamael Lunthistle asks that it be taken to Astarii Starseeker at the Temple of the Moon.

sections.title: A Golden Tablet
sections.body: Among the Twilight’s Hammer’s belongings in Searing Gorge lies a golden tablet bearing a prayer to Elune. It is Zamael Lunthistle’s prayer, and he asks that it be brought to Astarii Starseeker at Darnassus’s Temple of the Moon, so the prayer can be heard.

faq.q: What is the Prayer to Elune?
faq.answer: The Prayer to Elune is a prayer etched onto a golden tablet.
The golden tablet is among the Twilight’s Hammer’s belongings in Searing Gorge.
Zamael Lunthistle wants his prayer recovered and taken to Astarii Starseeker at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
The prayer is Zamael's. He says his faith has been rekindled and his prayer must be heard, though he expects no absolution. Astarii thanks you for returning a lost soul to Elune.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know Elune as your people’s goddess; this tablet carries a prayer meant to reach her.
